notes.title: 0.3.1 - Modifications, Commanders, Victory
notes.content:
The mission system was entirely deleted and replaced with a unique victory system. The victory system has three different methods by which you can win the game before time runs out. This should make the game faster and less tedious
You can now modify ships in the ship modification tab. You unlock ship modifications through technologies and randomly while playing the game. There are 12 ways to modify each of the basic light/medium/heavy ships, or 1728 in total.
You now acquire Commanders who will lead fleets into battle. They give you access to special abilities during battles which boost your ship stats for a period. This will need to be made more interesting in the future
Added lens flares to the battle skyboxes, added 4 new skyboxes
Reduced the size of the game by 300MB. Increased the performance of some game logic
Improved parts of the GUI. Improved the in-game tutorial
Added an Achievements tab in the main menu
Improved the title-placement algorithm
Added a rotation option to the custom flag maker
Fixed a problem with jagged edge antialiasing when zoomed out of the map
Added an action to increase the number of building slots on a planet


Pricing and Development:
I’m going to take a break from development for ~2 months unless there’s a major bug since I have other things to do. In addition, I have decided to “flip” the pricing of the game for Early Access. Instead of having large discounts combined with a high base price, the base price will be low with little to no discounts during sales. I feel that this will make the game more consistently accessible. If version 1.0 is reached, the price will go back up. Next versions will probably be about making the politics and diplomacy more interesting

notes.title: 0.2.3 - Structures
notes.content:
You can construct defenses and space city structures
 Changed the ship research tree so you can pick “paths” for ships at the start. This will need to be expanded upon a lot later
 It now shows the reason you can’t recruit ships. The planet viewer was simplified. Added 5 music tracks
 Improved map borders

Version 0.2.1

 Pirates will raid your territory in the early/mid game. Pirates have their own ship models, and can be paid off sometimes
 Map Titles: You can turn on and off titles over the map governments. The title-placing algorithm is inconsistent right now and will be changed later on
 Sending and expelling internal colonists from a planet is now a continuous process instead of a one-time action. A new action to speed up integration was added
 You can scale the UI in the Options menu
 AIs won’t spam the player asking for ententes. Simplified the ship technology menu and some descriptions

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
-Fixed a tooltip bug that crashes the game
-Changed to Unity 6. Windows 7 is no longer supported as a result

notes.title: Version 0.2
notes.content: Changed name to "Sidereal Dominion: Avalon", added early/preview version of map creator, added manpower building chain, minor UI improvements

notes.content: Fixed a typo causing a mission to be non completable
